strings.subtitle: — Onganyisa yofaili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Okukoka nokuleka ka ku lilipo. Tala ONGUELE yokuse yili kumosi.
strings.ssd_warning:
Ondaka! Ku SSD, ondonge yokuhandeka kombanda kayi kukova TRIM.
Omukanda uyu wa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faili "{name}" kulandeka kombanda no kulisapo.

Kusuela?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAILI YA LANDEKA KOMBANDA NO KUYISA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS osongo wovimbulu (ADS) ka u lingi.
• USN omukanda ka u pongololwa.
• Ovimbulu vyondembo no kuongolola kilunde
  (OneDrive ni okwambu) ka vi kwatwa.
strings.status_full: Ovimbulu vya landeka kombanda la seo. Okukumbulula ka ku talu — ovikanda vina okutala seo kiki.
strings.status_fast: Ombunda, osongo no 4 MB osongo ya landeka kombanda. Okwambu ka kya kwatwa, kanda omu kutukuka, okukumbulula vosi ovikanda vyosingana ka ku talu. Ku ovimbulu vyakusoka, linga MODO VOSI.
strings.status_empty: Faili ya kala uwa, okulandeka kombanda ka kya tala. Ya yiswa.
strings.error_permission: Ka tu kuta okukwata faili. Yi viali ku mukanda okwambu. Kanisa ni kusuela kavali.
strings.error_not_found: Faili ka yi sange. Yi viali ya yiswa kala.
strings.error_is_symlink: Eyi i odombo yokulingisa. Odombo ka yi nyiseka — faili yokulinga yi kala ku vukembe.
strings.error_reparse: Eyi i faili yondombo (OneDrive ile okwambu). Ovimbulu vyayo vili ku kilunde, ka ku disk. Ka ku se a nyiseka koku.
strings.error_not_file: Eyi ka i faili (ondambo ile okwambu). Leka faili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faili eyi ina odombo yosongo okwambu ({n} vosi). Odombo yosongo ka yi na omukulu — ovikumbi vosi via linga. Omu ku nyisa ku ondomba ya katesi, ovimbulu ku landeka kombanda ni kuketa ku 32 byte, kanda okusala ku kala ku odombo okwambu. Nyisa odombo yosi koku.
strings.error_compressed:
Faili ya finywa, ya kumbwa ile ka yi na vusongo. Kulandeka kombanda la seo ka ku kova okunyisa ovimbulu vyakala kwenda NTFS yi vindika koku okwambu.

Kusa ovimanyisa: kukola okweyo → Ovimanyisa → Okwambu → kusa ekumba "Finyi" ni/ile "Kumba". Kukoya, kala SHREDDER kavali.
